Besides looking totally awesome, are there really still benefits to installing a fully custom loop in a PC? There are much cheaper options now such as a closed loop system, and cards like the 980 hybrid and r9 295 have closed loops in them. It seems like a waste of money to buy all the parts for a custom loop.
Is There Still Any Point In Custom Water Cooling Loops?

I have an Fx-9590, which runs hotter than perhaps any other stock CPU. I use a cheap closed loop and it stays fine even at 100% load. I'm sure it's the same for any GPU. So no, there's no reason other than you ascend a little higher. Maybe with 4 GPUs you would have a reason but that's probably it.
The reason it runs hotter is because it's an "old" chip just overclocked, which is the perfect excuse for watercooling.
Sometimes boxed setups just done do it. Everybody has a unique situation, for your average consumer, I don't think the Custom Loops are really practical.
